name: Tape measure
summary: Retractable tape measure with a length of tape pulled out and a hook; for DIY, measuring and building scenes.

params.name: y
params.note: bottom centre: the case sits on the floor at y

params.name: s
params.note: scale; at s = 1 the item is hero size (about 430 px across); use about 0.3 next to a person

params.name: anim
params.note: spin = the reel turns as if winding the tape

params.name: flip
params.note: mirror (the tape then comes out to the left)

author: krakujs
